'''Chromium Garden''' was a garden located on the artificial world of [[Iokath]], next to [[Selruvian biome]] and the [[Tributary]]. In [[3630 BBY]] the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] leadership, trapped on Iokath by [[ARIES]], passed the Chromium Garden and took shelter inside the Tributary. They later used a [[Colossus droid|Colossus Droid]] to ward off smaller droids inside the Garden to buy themselves time to escape in a shuttle.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chromium Garden appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' '''Chapter IV: Where Dreams Die''' and '''Chapter V: Ascension'''.
